one_liner_zh: 羅克威爾 EPS 3.30 美元超預期14.6%、營收年增11.9%，工業自動化與數位轉型需求回溫。
one_liner_en: Rockwell beat EPS at $3.30 by 14.6% with 11.9% revenue growth, as automation and digital demand recovered.
beat_or_miss: 超預期：EPS 超預期 14.55%、營收年增 11.89%，雙雙穩健。
ai_view_zh: 訊號正向：營收與獲利雙超預期且回到雙位數成長，顯示工業自動化需求自低谷回溫，受再岸製造與數位化資本支出支撐。短期財報利多有助股價。惟約49倍本益比已高度定價復甦預期，任何訂單不如預期都可能引發回檔。中期追蹤訂單出貨比、軟體與經常性收入占比、各區域製造業景氣與毛利率。
ai_view_en: Signal is positive: revenue and earnings both beat with a return to double-digit growth, showing automation demand recovering from a trough, supported by reshoring and digitalization capex. Near term the beat aids the stock. However, a ~49x P/E heavily prices in recovery, so any order shortfall could trigger a pullback. Mid term, track book-to-bill, software/recurring revenue mix, regional manufacturing conditions and gross margin.
highlights_zh: EPS 3.30 美元，超預期 14.55%，獲利優於估計
營收 22.4 億美元，年增 11.89%，需求回溫
工業自動化、軟體與數位轉型訂單成長
再岸（reshoring）與製造業資本支出帶動需求
highlights_en: EPS of $3.30 beat by 14.55%, ahead of estimates
Revenue of $2.24B grew 11.89% on recovering demand
Growth in automation, software and digital transformation orders
Reshoring and manufacturing capex drive demand
risks_zh: 工業景氣循環敏感，訂單能見度隨製造業 PMI 波動
本益比約49倍，對工業股偏高
供應鏈與成本通膨壓力
risks_en: Industrial cyclicality; order visibility tracks manufacturing PMI
P/E of ~49x is high for an industrial
Supply chain and cost inflation pressure
